chunks: Sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.

key_terms.وَكِيلًا: Disposer of affairs, Guardian, One who manages affairs on behalf of others

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah is sufficient as a disposer of affairs?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq contextualizes this declaration within the doctrine of *Tawhid* and divine guardianship (*Wilayah*), emphasizing that Allah’s sufficiency (*Kafa'ah*) is the foundation for the Imam’s role as the earthly executor of divine will. This concept underscores the Shia belief that true reliance on God (*Tawakkul*) is intrinsically linked to recognizing the divinely appointed authority that manages worldly affairs under His ultimate command.
